name: Harari on AI & Power
tagline: Yuval Noah Harari on humanity, AI and power over the next 50 years, in 14 cards.
description: A 14-card scroller of Yuval Noah Harari's Mind Nutrients episode (8 August 2026): ten timestamped chapters on stories, democracy, AI as an agent, law, money and truth, plus four Harari books to read next. Built from the show notes and Nexus; no transcript.
